title: Byzantine-Resilient Federated Large Language Model via Hypergraph Message Passing
abstract: arXiv:2610.12711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Large Language Models (FedLLMs) are promising to deliver privacy-preserving, collaborative intelligence. The decentralized training process is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks that corrupt semantic consistency and factual resilience through malicious model updates. This paper presents a new resilience strategy that prevents semantically corrupted knowledge from propagating during federated aggregation. A defense problem is formulated to jointly maximize global accuracy and suppress manipulated model updates, enabling trustworthy knowledge aggregation without accessing private local data. To strengthen the resilience of FedLLMs, we develop a novel Hypergraph Message Passing Graph Autoencoder (HMP-GAE) framework, where low-rank model updates are represented as nodes in a hypergraph and high-order semantic relationships among multiple agents are exploited through iterative message passing. translated_title: 基于超图消息传递的拜占庭容错联邦大语言模型
translated_abstract: 联邦大语言模型有望提供保护隐私的协作智能。然而，去中心化的训练过程容易受到拜占庭攻击，恶意模型更新会破坏语义一致性与事实可靠性。本文提出了一种新的弹性防御策略，防止语义被破坏的知识在联邦聚合过程中传播。论文将防御问题形式化为同时最大化全局准确性并抑制被操纵模型更新的优化问题，从而在不访问私有本地数据的情况下实现可信的知识聚合。为了增强联邦大语言模型的抗攻击能力，我们开发了一种新颖的超图消息传递图自编码器框架，其中低秩模型更新被表示为超图中的节点，并通过迭代消息传递挖掘多个智能体之间的高阶语义关系。通过利用历史检查点和模型更新的演化信息（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 本文提出HMP-GAE框架，将低秩模型更新表示为超图节点，通过迭代消息传递利用多智能体间的高阶语义关系来识别并抑制恶意更新，从而在不访问私有数据的前提下防御拜占庭攻击、保障联邦大语言模型聚合的可信性。
